{{Top|leg}}
[[Diatium/Legends|Diatium]] was used in the construction of armor sheets that protected structures that were in close proximity to [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields. '''Diatium plating''', as [[droid armor]], was very rarely produced since it was prohibitively heavy and expensive to shape on such a small scale.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
